```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load the package from the checkout with pkgload; no package install is
# required. Under altdoc the render runs in a temp dir, so resolve the root
# first (CFB2NFL_ROOT in the site build, else walk up to the _targets store).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT", "")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  root <- if (file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets"))) dir else getwd()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

# One interaction style for every girafe figure: a clear hover pop, dimming
# of non-hovered marks, a dark tooltip, and toolbar zoom + PNG download.
set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

# thousands-separated and percent formatters for inline numbers
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)
```

```{r}
#| label: load
#| include: false
team_season <- dbReadTable(con, "team_season")
team_draft <- dbReadTable(con, "team_draft")
teams <- dbReadTable(con, "teams")
roster <- dbReadTable(con, "roster")
picks <- dbReadTable(con, "picks")
player_stats_seasons <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT DISTINCT playerId, season FROM player_stats"
)
stopifnot(nrow(team_season) > 0, nrow(team_draft) > 0, nrow(picks) > 0)

# Decision 0003 places Notre Dame in the Power tier, but the season-aware
# lookup tiers every FBS independent as Group of 5; apply the team override
# here so the exhibits match the tier definitions in section 2.1.
nd_power <- function(df) {
  mutate(
    df,
    tier_label = if_else(
      team == "Notre Dame" & tier_label == "Group of 5",
      "Power",
      tier_label
    )
  )
}
tier_order <- c("Power", "Group of 5", "FCS and below")
tier_colors <- c(
  "Power" = "#1d4ed8",
  "Group of 5" = "#f59e0b",
  "FCS and below" = "#6b7280"
)
team_season <- team_season |>
  nd_power() |>
  mutate(tier_label = factor(tier_label, levels = tier_order))
team_draft <- nd_power(team_draft)
stopifnot(
  all(team_season$tier_label[team_season$team == "Notre Dame"] == "Power")
)

first_class <- 2014L # full observable careers (roster starts 2010)
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is in progress
played <- filter(team_season, games_played > 0, season <= last_season)
n_played_2025 <- n_distinct(played$team[played$season == 2025L])
stopifnot(n_played_2025 > 600)
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-10-31. Rosters and
stat lines start with the 2010 season; the 2026 season is still being
played, so every season-level exhibit stops at 2025, and draft counts cover
the classes of 2014 through 2026.*
:::

## 1. Introduction

In 2025, `r fmt(n_played_2025)` college programs played at least one
recorded football game, from Alabama and Ohio State down to Division III,
and this post maps how they are grouped, what the data records about each,
and how unevenly the NFL draft draws from them. The answers set up two
later posts: which schools produce draftees at each position, and whether
winning explains it.

## 2. Data

### 2.1 Teams are grouped into conferences, and conferences into three tiers

The table defines every term the post uses; a tier is set season by
season, so a school that changes conference can change tier.

```{r}
#| label: terms
tibble::tribble(
  ~Term                   , ~Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ,
  "Division"              , "The NCAA level a school plays at: FBS (the top division), FCS (the next level down), Division II, and Division III."                                                                                                         ,
  "Conference"            , "A league of schools that schedule each other and share a championship, such as the SEC or the Big Sky. A few FBS schools are independents and belong to no football conference."                                         ,
  "Tier"                  , "Our three-level grouping of conferences by competitive level, set season by season because schools change conferences."                                                                                                     ,
  "Power"                 , "The top tier: the SEC, Big Ten, ACC, and Big 12; the Pac-12 through 2023 (the Pac-10 before 2011); the Big East through 2012; and Notre Dame."                                                                               ,
  "Group of 5"            , "The rest of FBS: the American Athletic (from 2013), Conference USA, Mid-American, Mountain West, Sun Belt, Western Athletic (through 2012), the two-school Pac-12 from 2024, and the independents other than Notre Dame." ,
  "FCS and below"         , "Every school outside FBS: the FCS (such as the Big Sky or Missouri Valley), Division II, and Division III."                                                                                                                  ,
  "Team-season"           , "One school in one season."                                                                                                                                                                                                   ,
  "Roster player-season"  , "One player listed on one school's roster in one season."                                                                                                                                                                     ,
  "Stat line"             , "At least one recorded statistic (a carry, catch, tackle, or kick) for a player in a season."                                                                                                                                ,
  "Position group"        , "The roster position, grouped: quarterback, running back (fullbacks included), receiver, tight end, offensive line, defensive line, linebacker, defensive back, and special teams. A roster with no position, or a generic one such as athlete, is 'Position not recorded'." ,
  "Draft class"           , "The players picked in one year's NFL draft; the class of 2016 was drafted in April 2016, after the 2015 college season."                                                                                                    ,
  "Draft-day school"      , "The college the NFL draft lists for a player."                                                                                                                                                                               ,
  "Credited pick"         , "A draft pick traced to the last college roster the player was on before the draft. A pick whose player appears on no roster cannot be credited."
) |>
  kable(caption = "Terms used throughout.")
```

## 3. Results

```{r}
#| label: s31-compute
#| include: false
fbs <- played |>
  filter(classification == "fbs") |>
  # the Pac-10 became the Pac-12 in 2011: a rename, not a move
  mutate(league = if_else(conference == "Pac-10", "Pac-12", conference))
moves <- fbs |>
  arrange(team, season) |>
  group_by(team) |>
  mutate(from = lag(league), from_tier = lag(as.character(tier_label))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(from), from != league)
n_moves <- nrow(moves)
n_movers <- n_distinct(moves$team)
fbs_n <- count(fbs, season, name = "teams")
fbs_2010 <- fbs_n$teams[fbs_n$season == 2010L]
fbs_2025 <- fbs_n$teams[fbs_n$season == 2025L]
n_conf_2025 <- n_distinct(
  fbs$league[fbs$season == 2025L & fbs$league != "FBS Independents"]
)
wave1 <- sum(moves$season %in% 2011:2014)
wave2 <- sum(moves$season %in% 2023:2024)
pac12_2024 <- sort(fbs$team[fbs$season == 2024L & fbs$league == "Pac-12"])
```

### 3.1 FBS grew from `r fbs_2010` to `r fbs_2025` teams, and `r n_movers` of them changed conference at least once

The table counts teams and conferences by tier in the seasons around the two
waves of realignment, the figure shows when the `r n_moves` conference
changes happened, and the tile chart traces every school that moved.

```{r}
#| label: s31-table
conf_by_tier <- played |>
  filter(conference != "FBS Independents" | is.na(conference)) |>
  group_by(season, tier_label) |>
  summarise(conferences = n_distinct(conference), .groups = "drop")
teams_by_tier <- count(played, season, tier_label, name = "teams")
sel <- c(2010L, 2012L, 2013L, 2014L, 2023L, 2024L, 2025L)
teams_by_tier |>
  left_join(conf_by_tier, by = c("season", "tier_label")) |>
  filter(season %in% sel) |>
  mutate(
    cell = if_else(
      tier_label == "FCS and below",
      fmt(teams),
      paste0(teams, " in ", conferences)
    )
  ) |>
  select(season, tier_label, cell) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tier_label, values_from = cell) |>
  left_join(count(moves, season, name = "moved"), by = "season") |>
  transmute(
    Season = season,
    `Power teams in conferences` = Power,
    `Group of 5 teams in conferences` = `Group of 5`,
    `FCS and below teams` = `FCS and below`,
    `FBS teams that changed conference` = coalesce(moved, 0L)
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Teams that played at least one recorded game, and the conferences they played in, by tier, in seasons around the two waves of realignment. Conference counts leave out the FBS independents. FCS-and-below counts grow from 2021 because Division II and III games enter the data then."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: s31-explain
#| fig-height: 6
moves_n <- moves |>
  count(season, name = "moves") |>
  tidyr::complete(season = 2011:2025, fill = list(moves = 0L)) |>
  mutate(wave = season %in% c(2011:2014, 2023:2024))
p <- ggplot(moves_n, aes(season, moves, fill = wave)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
```

```{r}
#| label: s32-compute
#| include: false
division_order <- c("FBS", "FCS", "Division II and below")
division_colors <- c(
  "FBS" = "#1d4ed8",
  "FCS" = "#0f766e",
  "Division II and below" = "#6b7280"
)
coverage <- played |>
  mutate(
    division = case_when(
      classification == "fbs" ~ "FBS",
      classification == "fcs" ~ "FCS",
      TRUE ~ "Division II and below"
    ),
    division = factor(division, levels = division_order)
  ) |>
  group_by(season, division) |>
  summarise(
    played = n(),
    with_stats = sum(has_stat_lines),
    with_roster = sum(n_roster > 0),
    depth = median(n_stat_players[has_stat_lines]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(share = with_stats / played)
cov_at <- function(s, d, col) coverage[[col]][coverage$season == s & coverage$division == d]
fcs_pre <- coverage |> filter(division == "FCS", season <= 2019L)
fcs_post <- coverage |> filter(division == "FCS", season >= 2021L)
low_post <- coverage |> filter(division == "Division II and below", season >= 2021L)
fbs_depth_2015 <- cov_at(2015L, "FBS", "depth")
fbs_depth_2016 <- cov_at(2016L, "FBS", "depth")
```

### 3.2 Every FBS team has stat lines every season, FCS teams only from 2021, and Division II and III teams almost never

The table counts, for each division and season, the teams that played and
the teams with at least one player stat line; the first figure tracks that
share, and the second shows how many players per team carry a stat line,
which doubles in 2016 when deeper stat records begin.

```{r}
#| label: s32-table
coverage |>
  mutate(cell = paste0(with_stats, " of ", played)) |>
  select(season, division, cell) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = division, values_from = cell) |>
  rename(Season = season) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Teams with at least one player stat line, of the teams that played at least one recorded game, by division and season, 2010 to 2025."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: s32-explain
#| fig-height: 6
p <- ggplot(coverage, aes(season, share, color = division)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.4) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(season, ", ", division, ": ", with_stats, " of ", played, " teams (", pct(share, 0), ")"),
      data_id = paste(season, division)
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2017.6,
    y = 0.3,
    label = paste0("2020: ", cov_at(2020L, "FCS", "with_stats"), " of ", cov_at(2020L, "FCS", "played"), " FCS teams\n(the FCS moved most of 2020 to spring 2021)"),
    hjust = 1,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = division_colors[["FCS"]]
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 2017.8,
    xend = 2019.8,
    y = 0.3,
    yend = cov_at(2020L, "FCS", "share") - 0.03,
    curvature = 0.2,
    color = division_colors[["FCS"]],
    arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.25, "cm"))
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2021.2,
    y = 0.85,
    label = "From 2021: every FCS team",
    hjust = 0,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = division_colors[["FCS"]]
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1.02)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2010, 2025, 3)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = division_colors, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    x = "Season",
    y = "Teams with a stat line",
    title = "The stat sheets cover FBS completely and FCS only recently"
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```
